BiblicalUsage: Tekoa or Tekoah = "a stockade"; n pr m; 1) a Judaite, son of Ashur and grandson of Hezron; n pr loc; 2) a town in the hill country of Judah near Hebron built by king Rehoboam of Judah; birthplace of Amos; 3) a wilderness area where king Jehoshaphat of Judah defeated the people of Moab, Ammon, and Mount Seir
